title: IngestReport
description: adapter ingest_report.json (SPEC 4.6). Schema version 1.6.0 (1.1.0: fhir_deleted; 1.2.0: profile_validation; 1.3.0: tombstoned, held; 1.4.0: omop; 1.5.0: fhir_unread; 1.6.0: connector).

profile_validation.description: the sample checked against the mapping's national profiles (JP Core, D-137); every outcome is in jp_core_validation.json beside the snapshot

fhir_deleted.description: resources removed from fhir-store because they left the source (ledger of loaded ids)

tombstoned.description: records dropped from the snapshot because the source deleted them in the delta window (tombstones.json beside the snapshot; dataflow review P0-1)

held.description: the night failed before loading: fhir-store and the lake were not loaded and CURRENT still names the previous snapshot (dataflow review P0-2)

fhir_unread.description: per resource type, how many resources carry each top-level element the box does not read (the inbound FHIR contract, docs/data/01, T-616); '*' counts a resource type not read at all. Element names only, never values

connector.description: 10E-9 (review 13-10): how long the connector took per message (a CSV or SQL row, an SS-MIX2 message, a FHIR resource), per table and for the whole source: counts and times only, never a value of a row. Absent in a report written before 1.6.0

omop.description: the dual write of the night into the OMOP store of record (flag omop.dual_write, T-106, D-339); null when the flag is off or the night was held

read_times.title: TableReadTimes
read_times.description: 10E-9: one table's (or the whole source's) read: messages, the connector's own seconds, the 95th percentile per message read from the histogram as its bucket's upper bound (null with no message, or when it falls above the last bound, which the histogram then shows), and the histogram by upper bound in milliseconds

connector_report.title: ConnectorReport
connector_report.description: 10E-9: the night's connector (the source kind), its whole read and each table's

sample_cap.description: T-693 (D-457): the most resources of one type the sample took; null: no cap

capped.description: T-693 (D-457): the resource types the cap cut, with the number of their resources

omop_load_summary.title: OmopLoadSummary
omop_load_summary.description: one feed batch loaded into the OMOP store by the adapter (T-106): all or nothing; a failure never holds the night

state.description: loaded: committed; refused: the store refused the batch (an older batch, a mass tombstone, a Data Quality hold), nothing written; failed: an error rolled the batch back, nothing written

counts.description: the loader's counts (inserted, updated, same, tombstoned, restored, concepts minted, open conflicts)

relational_checks.description: Data Quality Relational checks run after the load (isRequired, isPrimaryKey, isForeignKey)

relational_failed.description: the checks with violated rows: check name to rows

error.description: refused: the store's reason; failed: the error type only (a message can quote a cell)
